summaries.genai: Gen AI Specialist with 3.5+ years of experience and expertise in Python, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and multi-cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Built a Model Context Protocol server and multi-agent LLM automation at Turbot HQ that cut Azure resource-discovery latency 70-90% and gave enterprise teams real-time AI-driven access to cloud security data.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving large language models (LLMs) standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK, applying prompt engineering to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands, validate and test them in a live environment, self-correct failures, and score outcomes against an internal evaluation metric.

Built a RAG-based Pydantic AI agent to preprocess and index internal documentation and code as text data into S3 vector storage; deployed it to AWS Lambda and integrated it with the Slack Bot API for instant developer query resolution.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability/SIEM CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes to DuckDB; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to investigate pod logs and status and restore service.

Added multi-distro Linux smoke tests to the GitHub Actions CI/CD release pipeline for four open-source Go CLIs, hardening release safety and catching regressions across Linux distributions before deployment.

projects.name: General-Purpose AI Chatbot / Agent (Model Context Protocol)

projects.name: CIS Benchmark → Compliance Dashboard Generator
projects.description: Python CLI that automates compliance-dashboard authoring for a multi-cloud governance product. Preprocesses CIS benchmark XLSX workbooks (AWS, Azure) as text data and emits ready-to-deploy HCL dashboard config plus markdown docs. OOP resource model, custom HCL pretty-printer, openpyxl + pandas, distributed as a pip-installable package.
